description.en: The ID of the CEN instance.
The ID of the attached network instance.

description.zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region where the attached network instance is created.
The ID of the route table of the attached network instance.

description.zh:
网络实例类型。取值：

- **VPC**：专有网络。
- **VBR**：边界路由器。
description.en:
The type of the attached network instance.

Set the value to **VPC**, which indicates a virtual private cloud (VPC).

description.zh: 要撤回的路由条目的目标网段。
description.en: The destination CIDR block of the route that you want to withdraw.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn withdraw-published-route-entries --cen-id cen-sxjfjkjfkjfiein0000 --child-instance-id vpc-rj9gt5nll27onu70000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje79u1g4t0000 --destination-cidr-block 172.16.1.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
